title: Construction and magnetic study of two new dysprosium complexes with chain or tetranuclear structure

material_class.structural_family: phenoxo-bridged Dy2 chain linked by pyridine-N-oxide groups

synthesis.procedure: H2L (0.1 mmol, 30.9 mg) was dissolved in 10 mL DMF. A methanolic solution of Et3N (1.0 mL, 0.1 mol L−1) was added and the mixture was stirred for 5 min, after which solid Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.1 mmol, 45.6 mg) was added. The wine-colored solution was stirred for 10 min at room temperature, transferred to a 20 mL Teflon-lined reactor, heated at 80 °C for 72 h under autogenous pressure, and cooled to room temperature at 5 °C h−1. Red crystals of 1 were obtained.

reagents.name: triethylamine
reagents.amount: 1.0 mL of 0.1 mol L−1 methanolic solution

synthesis.time: stir 5 min then 10 min; heat 72 h; cool at 5 °C h−1
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 20 mL Teflon-lined reactor, solvothermal under autogenous pressure
synthesis.yield: 29.5 mg (43.6% based on the metal salt)

properties.summary: Dy3+ ions in 1 are ferromagnetically coupled through double μ-phenoxide bridges. χMT = 26.55 cm3 mol−1 K at room temperature (vs 28.34 expected for two Dy3+), decreases to 20.23 at 5 K, then rises to 21.04 at 2 K. Magnetization at 2–3 K (0–70 kOe) is unsaturated and M vs HT−1 plots do not superimpose, indicating anisotropy. Zero-field ac susceptibility (1 Hz–1 kHz) shows slow magnetic relaxation/SMM-like superparamagnetic behavior with QTM below ~4 K. Arrhenius/QTM+Orbach fit: Ueff = 18.0 K, τ0 = 1.86 × 10−6 s, τQTM = 0.475 ms; Cole–Cole α = 0.060–0.107 (2.0–4.0 K). Under 2 kOe, QTM is suppressed and two relaxation processes appear at 2–3 K; slow-process fit gives Ueff = 22.1 K, τ0 = 6.00 × 10−7 s, τQTM = 1.92 ms.

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; QTM + Orbach fit of ln τ vs T−1 from ac data 2.0–4.0 K

measurements.name: τ0
measurements.conditions: zero dc field, same fit as Ueff = 18.0 K

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: 2 kOe dc field; Orbach + QTM fit of the slow process

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear Dy4 cluster of phenoxo- and acetate-bridged Dy2 units linked by pyridine-N-oxide

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to complex 1, replacing Dy(NO3)3·6H2O with Dy(OAc)3·4H2O and using 0.2 mmol Et3N instead of 0.1 mmol Et3N. The H2L/DMF solvothermal protocol of 1 (10 mL DMF, 80 °C, 72 h, Teflon-lined reactor) was otherwise followed. Red crystals of 2 were obtained.

reagents.name: N′-(8-hydroxyquinoline-2-carboxaldehyde)pyridine-N-oxide-carbohydrazide
reagents.amount: 0.1 mmol, 30.9 mg (as in the procedure for 1)

reagents.name: dysprosium(III) acetate tetrahydrate
reagents.amount: used in place of 0.1 mmol Dy(NO3)3·6H2O; mass not separately stated

synthesis.yield: 30.2 mg (53.3% based on the metal salt)

properties.summary: Dy3+ ions in 2 are antiferromagnetically coupled (double μ-phenoxide plus anti–anti acetate bridges). χMT = 55.58 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K (vs 56.68 expected for four Dy3+), decreasing to 39.47 at 2 K. M vs H/T plots indicate anisotropy. Under zero dc field, ac susceptibilities show negligible χM″, excluding slow relaxation. Under 2 kOe, frequency-dependent ac signals appear but χM″ peaks only at 1 kHz, so an energy barrier could not be extracted.

source_locations.location: Magnetic properties of complex 2; Fig. 3, Fig. S11–S12
